description: Read Xiaohongshu notes, feeds, profiles and comments, post or reply to comments, like notes, and prepare image or video publishes on the creator platform in your current tab. Final note publishing is deferred.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read-only page observation. Optional view selects note, search/feed/profile, comments or filter extraction; installs no page runtime.

tools.name: check_login
tools.description: Check the sign-in state of the current Xiaohongshu tab without navigating away. Returns unknown when the page offers no reliable evidence.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search Xiaohongshu by keyword, navigating the current tab to the search result page. Call list_search_results afterward to read the rendered cards.

tools.name: list_search_results
tools.description: Read the loaded search result cards of the current /search_result page: title, author, note URL with its xsec_token, note type and cover. Returns currently loaded cards; repeat after the page updates.

tools.name: get_search_filters
tools.description: Reveal the search filter panel through site hover handlers and read its visible groups, options and selected states.

tools.name: apply_search_filters
tools.description: Apply search filter options (sort_by, note_type, publish_time, search_scope, location) on the current /search_result page and wait until refreshed results are observed or confirmed unchanged.

tools.name: open_note
tools.description: Open a note by its exact search-result URL in the current tab, preferring a rendered card click over direct navigation. Call read_current_note afterward to verify the opened page.

tools.name: read_current_note
tools.description: Read the currently open note: title, body, author, publish time, metrics, images and video, using the page state of the exact note ID with a rendered-DOM fallback.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: Read comments already loaded in the open note's page state: parent comments, their replies and the pagination cursor. Read-only; use load_more_comments for further pages.

tools.name: load_more_comments
tools.description: Load parent comments and expand replies in bounded multi-round calls. Supports max_comment_items, max_rounds, expand_replies, reply_limit and scroll_speed. Reports progress, stopping reasons and diagnostics; repeat after a call-budget yield.

tools.name: post_comment_to_feed
tools.description: Post a comment on the open note, or open feed_id with xsec_token first. Supports operation_id and status to recover uncertain submission without sending twice; waits for rendered evidence.

tools.name: reply_comment_in_feed
tools.description: Reply to a note comment by comment_id or author user_id, discovering unloaded targets through bounded scroll/expansion. Uses an operation journal and waits for rendered evidence; status never blindly resubmits.

tools.name: like_feed
tools.description: Set the desired liked state (liked or unlike); optionally open feed_id with xsec_token. Restores bounded two-click verification/recovery and reports attempts.

tools.name: open_home
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to the Xiaohongshu home feeds.

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: Read the home feed cards currently rendered: title, author, note URL with token and cover. Read-only.

tools.name: open_profile
tools.description: Open a user profile by its full profile URL or user ID in the current tab. Navigation returns before page content is ready; call read_profile to verify.

tools.name: read_profile
tools.description: Read the currently open profile: nickname, red ID, description, counts and the profile's note cards. Read-only.

tools.name: select_profile_tab
tools.description: Switch the currently open profile to its notes, favorites or liked tab and wait until its cards refresh.

tools.name: open_login
tools.description: Open the website sign-in panel by clicking a recognizable navigation control, then report the sign-in state. Completing sign-in is manual by design; no credentials are ever read.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Sign out of Xiaohongshu through the site's own navigation menus after an explicit confirm argument. Other Xiaohongshu tabs may also sign out.

tools.name: publish_content
tools.description: Prepare media publishing through open, prepare, upload(file_id), wait, configure and status. Configure accepts title/content, tags, products, visibility, schedule_at and is_original; it creates a persistent operation journal. Continue with resume(operation_id). Individual settings remain available. Upload validates media and converts supported images automatically. Inspect uncertain operations before retrying; final publication is manual. Use reset to abandon a stalled operation without replaying consumed files. After open, use the returned continuation on the creator origin.

tools.name: publish_video
tools.description: Prepare media publishing through open, prepare, upload(file_id), wait, configure and status. Configure accepts title/content, tags, products, visibility, schedule_at and is_original; it creates a persistent operation journal. Continue with resume(operation_id). Individual settings remain available. Upload validates media and converts supported images automatically. Inspect uncertain operations before retrying; final publication is manual. Use reset to abandon a stalled operation without replaying consumed files. After open, use the returned continuation on the creator origin.

tools.name: begin_file_transfer
tools.description: Begin an origin-local OPFS transfer on the creator tab. Accept name, mime and size (up to 4 GiB); return transfer_id, chunk_size and next_offset. Check quota first. Transfers expire after 24 hours; refresh preserves committed chunks.

tools.name: write_file_chunk
tools.description: Write the next base64 chunk at next_offset. Exact duplicate chunks are idempotent; changed duplicates, skipped offsets and invalid lengths fail. Use chunk_size except for the final chunk.

tools.name: finish_file_transfer
tools.description: Verify all chunks are complete and return file_id for one publishing handoff on this creator origin. Repeated finish is idempotent until consumption. Refresh preserves transfer state; an interrupted handoff must be inspected manually.

tools.name: transfer_remote_file
tools.description: Download an HTTP(S) image or video incrementally into OPFS; resume with transfer_id, then publish with the finished file_id. Remote server must allow this browser origin and honor Range for resume.

tools.name: prepare_media
tools.description: Validate image/video signatures; convert other browser-decodable images up to 20 MiB to PNG, returning a ready file_id. Publishing invokes this automatically.
